places-rio-frio-cavidad-ii.story: A 250 km round trip from Puebla de Don Fadrique - roughly 4 h 19 in the saddle. The stops in between: Abrigo del molino de Bagil, Cavidad II and back through Abrigo del molino de Bagil. The highest point is about 1,450 m. The line favours views over speed.

ca-pacific-marine-circle-route.slogan: Pacific Marine Circle Route – 152 km between Victoria and Victoria
ca-pacific-marine-circle-route.story: Repeated coastal bends, headlands and frequent viewpoint stops. It also links naturally to Vancouver Island temperate rainforest.
ca-pacific-marine-circle-route.legalNote: Check provincial road reports, wildfire closures, ferries and fuel range. Specific flag: weather; fuel gaps.

scenicChapters.title: Sooke → Lake Cowichan
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 56 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
